scope: Synthetic complete BF16-to-BF16 TP2 AllReduce timing and numerical error; no model accuracy or serving throughput qualification.

workload.input_generator: ref::gen_input then ref::gen_outliers; source magnitudes [1.0,0.5], Gaussian samples rounded to BF16,32 outliers per source at matched positions with magnitudes [40,20].

nccl.label: BF16 NCCL
nccl.correctness_reference: Full output bitwise equal to BF16-RNE(FP32(x0)+FP32(x1)); signed-zero direct-add semantics. Error metrics still use the unrounded FP32 reference.

fp8-ue8m0-lamport-batched.label: FP8 E4M3 + UE8M0, group128
fp8-ue8m0-lamport-batched.scale_rule: e=max(-120,ceil(log2(amax/448))); scale=2**e; scale_code=e+127; zero group code7
fp8-ue8m0-lamport-batched.arithmetic: E4M3 RNE source quantization; separate rank-ordered FP32 multiply/add with +0 seed; BF16 RNE output; no second FP8 quantization

fp8-mxfp8-lamport-batched.rounding: E4M3 RNE with finite saturation; BF16 RNE
fp8-mxfp8-lamport-batched.accumulation: separate FP32 multiply/add; +0 seed; source0 then source1
fp8-mxfp8-lamport-batched.label: MXFP8 E4M3 + E8M0, group32
fp8-mxfp8-lamport-batched.supported_numerics: finite decoded source terms and FP32 partial sums, BF16-representable output

timing_method.timed_scope: Full BF16-to-BF16 call including input quantization, communication, decode/reduction and internal synchronization. Compilation, allocation and one-float rank alignment are outside timing.
timing_method.per_sweep_statistic: For sample i, max(rank0_event_us_i,rank1_event_us_i)/10; sort200 values and use index100 (upper median). Archived samples are already per-call microseconds.
timing_method.across_sweeps: Median of the three sweep medians; range is min/max of these medians.
timing_method.speedups: Median of three paired within-sweep ratios; never ratio of aggregate medians.

comparison.geometry_selection: Inherited group128 pilot selection; no new tuning search for group32.

collective_settings.note: NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME selected the host control-network interface; NCCL_HOME/LIB/INC selected the audited 2.31.2 installation. Host interface/path identifiers are omitted.

accuracy_method.reference: r_i=FP32_add_rn(FP32_add_rn(+0,float(x0_i)),float(x1_i)) for original BF16 inputs; no low-precision codec is applied to the reference.
accuracy_method.relative_l2: sqrt(mean(e_i**2)/mean(r_i**2)); if reference mean square is zero, use RMSE
accuracy_method.reduction_precision: FP32 tensor subtraction, squares and means in PyTorch; host square root. These are measured metrics, not an FP64 error recomputation.
accuracy_method.aggregation: One eager metric record per input_set and format. All recorded eager, changed-graph and post-timing metrics agree for each seed across all three sweeps. Ranges are min/max over three seeds at each shape.
accuracy_method.pairing: Joined by rows/backend/input_set and expected seed; the common input generator/reference sources and native bridge binary hashes were verified across all sweeps. Original input tensors are not archived.
accuracy_method.scope: Actual group32 collective: full GPU numerical reference plus independent sampled NumPy output/received-wire checks. All reference work is untimed. Group128 retains its original independent oracle and frozen-baseline gates.

raw_reports_note: Hashes identify private complete reports. Public JSON retains per-sweep timings, paired ratios and measured per-seed errors; it omits host paths and scheduler metadata.
